name: fz552_illusion_damaginghit_order
purpose: Illusion's onDamagingHit has no order (data/abilities.ts:2071-2075), so the disguise ends after the ordered DamagingHit handlers and, among the unordered ones, in target order (compareLeftToRightOrder, sim/battle.ts:421-426). Step 1: Golurk's Iron Head hits Zoroark-Hisui (p1b, disguised as Banette, holding a Rocky Helmet): the helmet's -damage on Golurk comes before replace / -end Illusion. Step 4: Rock Slide hits Polteageist (p1a, Weak Armor) and Zoroark-Hisui, disguised again after a switch: Weak Armor's lines come before the replace (issue 552). Synthetic teams; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
